newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-CHANG REACHES SEMIFINALS AGAIN AT AUSTRALIAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CHANG REACHES SEMIFINALS AGAIN AT AUSTRALIAN OPEN.

text.p: World number two Michael Chang, who is fighting for his first grand slam title for eight years, reached the semifinals of the Australian Open on Tuesday for the third straight year.
The number two seed once again looked on top form as he beat tournament danger man Marcelo Rios of Chile 7-5 6-1 6-4 in just under two hours.
Rios, the number nine seed, beat Sweden's Thomas Enqvist in five tight sets on Sunday.
But the 21-year-old from Santiago, Latin America's most successful player, seemed to have little in reserve as Chang stormed around the court mopping up any stray shots.
Chang lost to Germany's Boris Becker in last year's Australian Open final. The previous year he was ousted in the semifinals by world number one Pete Sampras.
